div.div:
Key Mechanics:
• Exactly-One Receiver: Each message delivered to one worker only.
• Dynamic Load Distribution: Faster workers drain more work.
• Destructive Consumption: Message deleted upon ACK.

div.div:
Key Mechanics:
• One-to-Many Broadcast: Every registered group receives all messages.
• Subscriber Independence: Slow group B never throttles fast group A.
• Non-Destructive Reads: Messages retained according to log retention policy.
